source_policy: Resolve and freeze SHA256 of whole cores, registered encoder and normalization artifacts before preflight; no source95 substitution.

train.selection: torch.randperm(70000, generator seeded 117+seed)[:4096]; map i<1000 to i, otherwise i+640; preserve this order
train.optimizer_start: fresh Adam, not historical optimizer continuation
train.old_loss: unchanged phase primary + 5 * positive-product actual-spike loss
train.encoder: frozen registered native encoder and fixed normalization

eval.readout: actual event * gate traces; unchanged production positive component-Pearson product, threshold 0.50, min group size 2, largest component background

promotion.comparisons: both matched control and initial SW0097
promotion.bootstrap: 10000 paired resamples, RNG seed113; draw the SAME image indices across all three seeds; mean seed-wise paired deltas; two-sided percentile 95% CI lower bound >0 against both references; conditional on these fixed seeds

integrity.labels: GT only for frozen endpoint scoring; never for training, mask construction, thresholds, preflight selection or coefficient tuning
integrity.mask_contract: no decoder mask, GT object count, gate-only final prediction, or alternate classifier
integrity.failures: Technical preflight failure stops this branch without parameter retuning; endpoint failure is retained and does not cancel unrelated experiments.
integrity.dependencies: own source/cache/implementation/preflight checks only; no SW108 or SW109 completion barrier

matched_control_reuse: Allowed only after SHA-verified identical source, train IDs/order, eligible legacy core parameters, old loss, optimizer, clipping, forward and core update identity. Otherwise run a fresh paired control. SW0097 initial metrics are a separate reference, never the 256-update matched control.
hypothesis: A small learned bounded correction to the legacy delayed scalar gate can recover assignment information lost at the gate without replacing the raw mapping as in SW100.

intervention.parameters: shared w[8], b[1], nine total; all exact zeros at construction, no RNG consumed
intervention.bounds: g0^2 <= gprime <= 2*g0-g0^2, hence [0,1]; no extra clipping
intervention.carrier: sin(theta_current)*gprime, same original shape and delay semantics
intervention.membrane: same scalar gprime passed to membrane gate; preserve existing repeat_interleave(D) fold order
intervention.actual_spikes: actual event*gprime; recurrence/reset/dendritic feedback see this actual trace
intervention.candidate: train nine gate parameters plus same eligible non-graph legacy core as control
intervention.control: nine parameters fixed zero, same eligible legacy core train
intervention.optimizer: core+gate fresh Adam3e-5; combined gradient clipping norm1
intervention.default: legacy mode remains default; opt-in adapter, no copied core or four-component membrane adapter

preflight: Zero parameters reproduce original carrier, scalar membrane gate, neuron states, actual spikes, q and old losses exactly under deterministic execution.
First four TRAIN batches: residual gradients finite and nonzero; log legacy core and residual gradient norms before combined clip.
Bounds, folded channel ordering, delayed first-step history and event*gate reconstruction verified.
Adapter is scoped to the sinusoidal_gating binding actually used by SNN forward, restored in finally; isolated worker process and no persistent monkeypatch leakage.
Checkpoint explicitly stores gate parameters/config; strict load roundtrip reproduces candidate actual readout.
No encoder/legacy graph changes; no delay/init/LR/residual coefficient sweep after scoring.
claims: Tests a learned raw-gate correction, not phasor invariance, restored binary rhythm, or physical causality of every gate.
